English: Wait! I... I have questions!
Questions?
What questions could you possibly have? I already spelled it out for you!
Jian did what?! This is a grave betrayal of The Order!
I'm afraid so. I think it's time we heard what Lady Unterwald has to say for herself.
I managed to obtain this recording from Lady Unterwald's safe. I believe it may contain her final instructions.
Sister Gretchen, fetch the gramophone!
OOooOOooh! I speak to you now, from beyond the grave!
Who dares to wake me from my eternal slumber?
We're sorry, Lady Unterwald!
Forgive us, we failed you!
Oh ho-ho! I'm just kidding around.
Although if you're listening to this recording, that means I've kicked the bucket.
I assume things have predictably descended into chaos, otherwise you wouldn't be seeking my guidance here.
For general business enquiries, select track one.
If you have an accounting question, select track two.
If you're seeking guidance on my last will and testament, select track three.
For anything else, select track four.
Ooh, she mentioned the will! Track three, pick track three!
So, you've got a question about my last will and testament.
Did somebody tear it to shreds in dramatic fashion? Accidentally submerge the documents in water? Set fire to the whole bloody lot, I'm guessing?
I always said it'd ruffle some feathers, oh-ho ho!
If my estate attorney is indisposed, or you're listening to this yourself, Arthur...
I've always retained a copy of my will and testament at the Unterwald family mansion. You'll find your answers there!
The mansion, of course!
I shall inform Herman Merman at once!
Wasn't he being detained?
You underestimate the man.
I suspect he's already free from his bonds and taking matters into his own hands!
If her attorney hadn't retrieved that missing will, we'd have never uncovered the truth.
What truth would that be?
Go on, Diana. What happened after you and Mr Ackerman recovered the will?
The family insisted on an impromptu reading of the will, which distracted everyone long enough for me to poke around...
Ugh, my head... What's going on?
Oh, for goodness' sake.
I came to rescue you two, of course!
Well, that's just splendid. I feel safer already!
Listen, we'll need to work together to get out of here.
How about you, Arthur?
I can assure you, I'm not here to steal anyone's inheritance!
That's exactly what someone trying to steal our inheritance would say!
We challenge you to another rematch!
Please, no!
What the hell are you doing? Where are the prisoners?
Huh?
Imbeciles! Must I do everything myself?
Excuse me, but I have to ask.
Why is everything shaking?
Take a look out the window, Gunter.
See if you can tell what's going on.
It looks like...
Oh my...
Well? What is it?
I think the train's about to...
I think it's about to...
About to what? Spit it out!
I think-
I don't think that's going to be much use.
Agent M!
You know each other?
She's my assigned field agent!
I'll explain later!
Here, let me untie your binds!
I'm free!
Okay, move out!
This seems like a bad idea.
Focus. We need to get out of here!
The twins really made a mess of all those papers.
If I wasn't preoccupied, I'd feel the urge to neatly organise it!
No time for that now, Arthur.
I can't really see them from here.
My first mission in the field, I can hardly believe it!
There's so much to remember, so much that can go wrong. I feel like I'm sweating buckets.
I'm nervous, April. Was this a mistake?
Hey, you've earned this. Don't you forget that.
Besides, didn't you want the chance to show those losers in Accounting how it gets done?
You're right. It just doesn't feel real to me yet.
You're too used to being underestimated and ignored by a bunch of relics in their stuffy suits.
Pretty much anyone with a modicum of power, if you think about it.
Now they want to put me on a mission, in the field? I'm not sure that it makes sense.
Talking of stuffy suits, here comes one now.
Ladies, how are we this fine morning?
April Benelli, as you very well know, my name is not ‘Phil'.
If you insist on addressing me by name, it's Sir Philately Stamp.
Yes, Sir Philately Stamp, Sorry Sir!
*Sigh* Let's just dispense with the pleasantries shall we?
Diana, there's no easy way to say this...
You're off the mission.
Oh, I stand corrected! There was an easy way to say it!
Word came from up top, we're to shut down this whole unit.
But, why?
Oh, the usual. Something about a bloated budget, the numbers not adding up.
Accounting is ironically quite unaccountable when it comes to things like answering questions.
Sorry to be the bearer of bad news. If you came here looking for mission gadgets, or to requisition a vehicle; I'm afraid we already relocated anything useful.
Now, I best be off. This red tape isn't going to put itself up!
Oh, April, this was my best shot at getting into the field. I'm just so tired of being a civil servant.
Is that right? Well, I'm tired of being civil.
Come on, we're getting you on that train!
If they won't let you join the party, we'll crash it in style!
This bike could be our ride out of here, Diana!
It's a little beaten up, but it should still be salvageable.
What do you think?
Brilliant! I'll take a look around.
If we get this bike working, I'll drive us right out of here!
Ladies and gentlemen, we are gathered here today to mourn the passing of our dear, Lady Unterwald.
Struck down by her scheming attorney, a meddling detective and a train-wrecking saboteur.
At least we can take some comfort in knowing that those three are securely behind bars.
Thank you, Arista.
I have, in my possession, the last known copy of Lady Unterwald's Last Will & Testament.
Arista must have provided the executor with a fake copy of the will.
Lady Unterwald said that a copy of her genuine will is kept here, I have to find it before the reading finishes!
Incredible, it worked!
We need to get this to the executor and confront the family at once!
Leave my entire estate to my dear sister-in-law, Arista Gudrun.
Ha ha, yes!
Alright, Mr Liu. It's time to honour our agreement.
I hope you can still hold a pen?
Mmmpfff.
Stop the reading at once!
You three again? What are you doing here?
What's all this?
That document is a fake! We have the genuine copy right here!
Mmmph!! Mmmmf!
Ladies and gentlemen, this looks to be genuine.
However, we should postpone the reading until I can evaluate the authenticity.
Well done, Arthur. We owe you a great debt.
I suppose you'll be running the estate now that you own the place?
Oh, I hadn't even thought about that.
It can be more of an advisory role, you know.
Say, Arthur. I don't suppose you'd be interested in a job?
You want me to work for Inland Revenue?
I'm afraid it'd be a strictly bureaucratic position, for now.
The amount of paperwork generated from this mission alone will keep us occupied for months.
We'd need a professional lackey to sort through this mess.
You said there'd be paperwork, and bureaucracy?
Oh yes, stacks of it, I'm afraid.
And you'd have to be comfortable wearing the uniform, of course.
There's a uniform?
That's right, but it's perhaps a little unadventurous for your taste.
I'll take it!
There's one more locking mechanism to get through.
This looks like another voice activated lock.
Is it expecting a fingerprint of some sort?
Wha-! What was that!
I feel so strange.
Everyone, listen to me!
I said, listen to m-
It's over, Arista. There's no getting out of this one.
WHAAAAAA?
Doctor Hirsch? I killed you! You should be dead!
Wait, did I say that out loud?
What's happening?
Looks like someone got a strong dose of truth serum.
Ladies and gentlemen, I'm afraid an attempt was made on my life with this poison dart.
Why didn't it work?
It was no different to the one I used to kill your dear Lady Unterwald!
Mother?
Mmphh?!
Why couldn't she just sell the estate? We'd have all been rich instead of living in her shadow!
You treasonous goat!
What have you done to me?
Why did I say that?
What did you do, mother?
Seize her!
I think it's time to leave, boys. Help your dear mother escape!
Let's leave him here for now, my arms are getting tired.
I should check on the doctor, but keep my distance from those ghastly twins.
I should look around for clues.
Did we get here first?
Where is everybody?
And you're quite sure, Doctor Hirsch?
Uh oh, they're heading this way.
Indeed. We believe the murder weapon was fired as a projectile.
Hide!
Well, this is quite the development.
That's not all, Arista.
Oh, what's that? There's more?
The dart, it was tipped with some sort of poison.
Did I hear you right? Did you say poison?
Even if the dart hadn't hit an artery, I'm afraid Lady Unterwald's death was inevitable.
The killer wasn't leaving it to chance, then.
Tell me, who else knows about this?
I will consult with the rest of the order this evening.
I wanted to bring my findings to family members first, out of courtesy.
Of course. My dear sister would have appreciated that.
Thank you for bringing this to my attention, doctor.
Oh, would you turn around and tell me what that is over there, dear?
Ackkk!
Oh my, Doctor Hirsch!
I'm afraid the poor doctor has taken a tumble, Gunter!
We need to move quickly. Take him to the basement, the both of you!
Come to the lounge when you're finished, the executor is about to read Lady Unterwald's will.
Is this about our inheritance, mother?
I intend to sell the estate over to Mr Liu, as soon as we gain control of the assets.
He may have broken every bone in his body, but I'm sure he can manage a signature.
Yes, mother!
They're gone, the coast is clear.
Doctor Hirsch revealed the killer to us, but at what cost?
What a twist. My novel is going to be a real page turner.
We need to focus on finding the original will and testament.
We can't let them benefit from that fraudulent copy.
Arthur, you head to the library room.
Alright! I can catch up on some light reading.
I'll check in on Lady Unterwald's private study.
Herman, you check out the basement.
I get the murder basement? Are you trying to get me killed?
We can use the pneumatic tube system to send each other any clues we find.
That's definitely more refined than the prison tube system.
Oh good, I'm not too late to the party!
Who the hell are you?
Stop him, boys!
We won't let you near our mother!
You'll have to go through us first!
That suits me just fine.
Allow me to introduce you to hammer and chisel!
Isn't that Dirk Chiselton fighting the twins?
Oh no. Why'd it have to be Chiselton?
Looks like we got here just in time, Chiselton.
How'd you figure it out?
Those three laid a lot of the groundwork. I just put the pieces together.
Well, we'd better get these three back to the station.
You can't arrest me, I'm innocent!
And rich! You can't put rich people in handcuffs!
Shut up, both of you!
Come on, let's go!
That was some fine detective work, Herman.
It was?
Listen, Herman, I've got a case that's been bugging me for a while.
Wouldn't mind another pair of eyes on it, if you're interested?
You're suggesting we form some sort of crime fighting detective duo?
Yeah, something like that. Are you in?
It's all I've ever wanted!
Well, Diana...
You disrespected my orders, stole a bunch of classified gadgets, and blew up an express train.
However, I can't argue with results.
Congratulations, field agent.
I've got the job? I'm a field agent!
I knew you could do it, Diana!
There's the train!
Can you get us any closer?
I'll try!
Damn it, this is as fast as we can go!
We're too far away!
Diana, think of something quick, or we're going to miss the train!
On it!
Who's out there? Reveal yourself!
Is Diana there?
You know Diana?
Keep your voice down!
Who are you?
Listen, I'm from the Inland Revenue Secret Service!
Is this about my self assessment? You people are relentless!
I'm not here about your taxes, idiot! I'm trying to break you out.
A jailbreak? Are you mad?
What about my reputation? I'd be branded an escaped fugitive!
On the other hand, it would definitely give a boost to my book sales.
Listen, Herbert! Stop daydreaming and pay attention!
We need to get you three to Lady Unterwald's mansion!
The mansion?
The family are preparing a second will reading!
I suppose it would be an opportunity to clear my name.
Then there's no time to waste!
Do you have anything in your cells that could bend those bars?
Nothing immediate comes to mind. I'll have to think about it.
You might want to stand away from the wall!
Hey! Stop escaping, you ruddy delinquents!
Thanks for breaking me out of the joint.
Are you sure you don't want to come with us?
It's been a blast, but ol' Donny's got to fend for himself, y'know?
Hey, you give those crooks a beating for ol' Don, ya hear me?
Good luck to ya guys!
Hop on, everyone.
Where are we going?
We need to get to that mansion!
I was sure Lady Unterwald was deliberately trying to evade scrutiny of her finances.
Why bury mountains of contradictory paperwork in her hidden safe?
Someone must be trapped inside!
LET ME OUT!
IS ANYONE THERE?
HELP!
